item.title: Ashoka Chakra for Astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla; 301 Gallantry Honours Conferred
item.description: The Centre on Sunday honoured Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla with the Ashoka Chakra, India’s highest peacetime gallantry award, recognising his historic achievement as the first Indian to visit the International Space Station (ISS). Shukla scripted history by spending 18 days in space as part of the Axiom Mission-4 (Ax-4), becoming only the second Indian to travel to space and the first from the country to set foot on the ISS.
